req.title: Task creation persists
req.statement: The system shall commit new task rows so subsequent GET calls return them across requests.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-021 requires that POST /tasks/ commits new task rows so subsequent GET calls return them. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — a valid task is created and retrievable via GET /tasks/{id}; (2) negative NEG — invalid payloads (empty title, title too long, description too long) are rejected with 422; (3) boundary BVA — title at exactly 1 char (min) and 100 chars (max) are accepted, title at 101 chars is rejected; (4) STC — state transition from non-existent to persisted, verified by GET; (5) DT — completed=true and completed=false both persist correctly. All tests use in-process TestClient with a fresh in-memory SQLite DB to ensure isolation and determinism.

tests.name: test_create_task_positive_persists_via_get
preconditions: App is running in-process with a clean in-memory SQLite database
No tasks exist with the title 'Buy groceries' in the test DB
actions: POST /tasks/ with valid payload {title: 'Buy groceries', description: 'A', completed: true}
Assert HTTP 201 and response body fields
GET /tasks/{id} using the returned id
Assert HTTP 200 and that the retrieved task matches the created task
expected: Response contains id (int), title='Buy groceries', description='A', completed=true
GET response body matches POST response body exactly on id, title, description, completed
trace: R-TASK-021: new task rows committed so subsequent GET calls return them
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

engine_mem = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
SessionMem = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem)

def override_get_db():
    db = SessionMem()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_positive_persists_via_get():
    payload = {'title': 'Buy groceries', 'description': 'A', 'completed': True}
    r_post = client.post('/tasks/', json=payload)
    assert r_post.status_code == 201
    body = r_post.json()
    assert body['title'] == 'Buy groceries'
    assert body['description'] == 'A'
    assert body['completed'] == True
    assert isinstance(body['id'], int)
    task_id = body['id']
    r_get = client.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    got = r_get.json()
    assert got['id'] == task_id
    assert got['title'] == 'Buy groceries'
    assert got['description'] == 'A'
    assert got['completed'] == True

test_create_task_positive_persists_via_get()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

engine_mem8 = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
SessionMem8 = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem8)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem8)

def override_get_db8():
    db = SessionMem8()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db8
client8 = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_decision_table_completed_true_and_false():
    r1 = client8.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Read chapter 5', 'completed': True})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    b1 = r1.json()
    assert b1['completed'] == True
    assert b1['title'] == 'Read chapter 5'
    g1 = client8.get(f'/tasks/{b1["id"]}')
    assert g1.status_code == 200
    assert g1.json()['completed'] == True
    r2 = client8.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Run unit tests', 'completed': False})
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    b2 = r2.json()
    assert b2['completed'] == False
    assert b2['title'] == 'Run unit tests'
    g2 = client8.get(f'/tasks/{b2["id"]}')
    assert g2.status_code == 200
    assert g2.json()['completed'] == False
    all_tasks = client8.get('/tasks/')
    assert all_tasks.status_code == 200
    ids = [t['id'] for t in all_tasks.json()]
    assert b1['id'] in ids
    assert b2['id'] in ids

test_create_task_decision_table_completed_true_and_false()
